    Accent = Color3.fromRGB(115, 90, 240),
    On = Color3.fromRGB(45, 185, 110),
    Off = Color3.fromRGB(210, 70, 75),
    Warn = Color3.fromRGB(235, 160, 45),
    TextPrimary = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 250),
    TextMuted = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 160)
}

-- ===== Variables d'état =====
local lastInteractionTime = os.clock()
local crypticActive = false

-- =============================================================================
-- FONCTIONS UTILITAIRES & SÉCURITÉS
-- =============================================================================
local function corner(instance, radius)
    local UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    UICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
    UICorner.Parent = instance
    return UICorner
end

local function stroke(instance, color, thickness, transparency)
    local UIStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    UIStroke.Color = color
    UIStroke.Thickness = thickness
    UIStroke.Transparency = transparency or 0
    UIStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    UIStroke.Parent = instance
    return UIStroke
end

local function tween(instance, properties, duration, style)
    if not instance or not instance.Parent then return end
    duration = duration or 0.15
    style = style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad
    local info = TweenInfo.new(duration, style, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    local t = TweetService:Create(instance, info, properties)
    t:Play()
    return t
end

local function verifyOwner()
    return true, LocalPlayer.Name, "Administrateur"
end

local function isWhitelisted(username)
    if Config.OpenMode then return true end
    if username == LocalPlayer.Name then return true end
    for _, name in pairs(Config.Whitelist) do
        if name:lower() == username:lower() then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function addToWhitelist(username)
    if not isWhitelisted(username) then
        table.insert(Config.Whitelist, username)
    end
end

local function removeFromWhitelist(username)
    for i, name in pairs(Config.Whitelist) do
        if name:lower() == username:lower() then
            table.remove(Config.Whitelist, i)
            break
        end
    end
end

-- ===== Gestion des Messages =====
local function sendChatMessage(message)
    if Config.SilentMode or message == "" then return end
    
    local ok = pcall(function()
        if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
            local channel = TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
            if channel then
                channel:SendAsync(message)
            end
        else
            local chatEvents = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents")
            local sayMessage = chatEvents and chatEvents:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest")
            if sayMessage then
                sayMessage:FireServer(message, "All")
            end
        end
    end)
    
    if not ok then
        warn("[Verity] Échec de l'envoi du message.")
    end
end

local function processMessage(sender, message)
    if sender == LocalPlayer then return end
    if not isWhitelisted(sender.Name) and not Config.OpenMode then return end

    local cleanMessage = string.lower(message)
    local senderName = sender.DisplayName or sender.Name
    lastInteractionTime = os.clock()

    if Config.AngryMode then
        for keyword, replies in pairs(AngryChatResponses) do
            if string.find(cleanMessage, keyword, 1, true) then
                local reply = replies[math.random(1, #replies)]
                sendChatMessage(string.gsub(reply, "{player}", senderName))
                return
            end
        end
    end

    for keyword, replies in pairs(ChatResponses) do
        if string.find(cleanMessage, keyword, 1, true) then
            local reply = replies[math.random(1, #replies)]
            sendChatMessage(string.gsub(reply, "{player}", senderName))
            return
        end
    end
end

-- =============================================================================
-- SÉCURITÉ ANTI-CRASH : NETTOYAGE DES ANCIENNES INSTANCES
-- =============================================================================
if PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("XenoBotGUI") then 
    PlayerGui.XenoBotGUI:Destroy() 
    task.wait(0.1)
end

-- =============================================================================
-- MESSAGES ALÉATOIRES (Boucle Idle)
-- =============================================================================
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        local waitTime = math.random(Config.IdleIntervalMin, Config.IdleIntervalMax)
        task.wait(waitTime)
        if Config.AutoChatEnabled and (os.clock() - lastInteractionTime) >= waitTime then
            local phraseList = Config.AngryMode and Config.AngryIdleMessages or Config.IdleMessages
            if #phraseList > 0 then
                local phrase = phraseList[math.random(1, #phraseList)]
                sendChatMessage(phrase)
                crypticActive = (Config.AngryMode and phrase == Config.CrypticMessage)
                lastInteractionTime = os.clock()
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- =============================================================================
-- TOUCHES RAPIDES (KEYBINDS)
-- =============================================================================
local KeyAliases = {
    Ctrl = Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl,
    Shift = Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift,
    Alt = Enum.KeyCode.LeftAlt,
    Space = Enum.KeyCode.Space,
}

local function resolveKeyCode(keyName)
    keyName = keyName:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if KeyAliases[keyName] then return KeyAliases[keyName] end
    local ok, code = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[keyName] end)
    if ok and code then return code end
    return nil
end

local ActiveKeybinds = {}

local function registerKeybind(keyName, phrase)
    local code = resolveKeyCode(keyName)
    if code then ActiveKeybinds[code] = phrase return true end
    return false
end

for keyName, phrase in pairs(Config.Keybinds) do registerKeybind(keyName, phrase) end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    local phrase = ActiveKeybinds[input.KeyCode]
    if phrase then task.spawn(function() sendChatMessage(phrase) end) end
end)

-- =============================================================================
-- CRÉATION DE L'INTERFACE VISUELLE (GUI)
-- =============================================================================
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "XenoBotGUI"

ScreenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true

local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")

MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Panel
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -135, 0.4, -240)
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 270, 0, 480)
MainFrame.Active = true
MainFrame.Draggable = true
corner(MainFrame, 14)
stroke(MainFrame, Theme.FieldBorder, 1, 0.3)

-- Topbar
local TopBar = Instance.new("Frame")
TopBar.Parent = MainFrame
TopBar.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.TopBar
TopBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42)
corner(TopBar, 14)

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Parent = TopBar
Title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 0)
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 1, 0)
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Text = Config.BotName:upper()
Title.TextColor3 = Theme.TextPrimary
Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Title.TextSize = 14
Title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

-- Bouton Fermer
local CloseBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
CloseBtn.Parent = TopBar
CloseBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 28)
CloseBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -35, 0.5, -14)
CloseBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.TopBar
CloseBtn.Text = "✕"
CloseBtn.TextColor3 = Theme.TextMuted
CloseBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
CloseBtn.TextSize = 12
corner(CloseBtn, 6)
CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() ScreenGui:Destroy() end)

-- Zone de défilement du contenu
local ContentFrame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
ContentFrame.Parent = MainFrame
ContentFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ContentFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 50)
ContentFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -60)
ContentFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
ContentFrame.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
ContentFrame.ScrollBarThickness = 4
ContentFrame.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Theme.Accent

local Layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
Layout.Parent = ContentFrame
Layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
Layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center

local function makeToggle(label, getState, onToggle)
    local Card = Instance.new("Frame")
    Card.Size = UDim2.new(0, 240, 0, 40)
    Card.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Field
    Card.Parent = ContentFrame
    corner(Card, 8)
    
    local Lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    Lbl.Parent = Card
    Lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
    Lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 1, 0)
    Lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Lbl.Text = label
    Lbl.TextColor3 = Theme.TextPrimary
    Lbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    Lbl.TextSize = 12
    Lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    
    local Btn = Instance.new("TextButton")

    Btn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -50, 0.5, -10)
    Btn.BackgroundColor3 = getState() and Theme.On or Theme.Off
    Btn.Text = ""
    corner(Btn, 10)
    
    Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        onToggle()

end

local function makeTextField(placeholder, defaultValue, onCommit)
    local Card = Instance.new("Frame")
    Card.Size = UDim2.new(0, 240, 0, 40)
    Card.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Field
    Card.Parent = ContentFrame
    corner(Card, 8)
    
    local Box = Instance.new("TextBox")
    Box.Parent = Card
    Box.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0)
    Box.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
    Box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Box.Text = tostring(defaultValue)
    Box.PlaceholderText = placeholder
    Box.TextColor3 = Theme.TextPrimary
    Box.PlaceholderColor3 = Theme.TextMuted
    Box.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    Box.TextSize = 12
    Box.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    Box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
    
    Box.FocusLost:Connect(function() onCommit(Box.Text) end)
end

-- Ajout des éléments à l'interface
makeToggle("🏃 Suivi Automatique", function() return Config.FollowEnabled end, function() Config.FollowEnabled = not Config.FollowEnabled end)
makeToggle("💬 Chat Automatique", function() return Config.AutoChatEnabled end, function() Config.AutoChatEnabled = not Config.AutoChatEnabled end)
makeToggle("😠 Mode Angry", function() return Config.AngryMode end, function() Config.AngryMode = not Config.AngryMode end)
makeToggle("🔇 Mode Silencieux", function() return Config.SilentMode end, function() Config.SilentMode = not Config.SilentMode end)
makeToggle("🌐 Mode Ouvert à tous", function() return Config.OpenMode end, function() Config.OpenMode = not Config.OpenMode end)

makeTextField("🏷️ Modifier nom du bot", Config.BotName, function(text) if text ~= "" then Config.BotName = text Title.Text = text:upper() end end)
makeTextField("📏 Distance de suivi", Config.FollowDistance, function(text) Config.FollowDistance = tonumber(text) or Config.FollowDistance end)

local StatusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
StatusLabel.Parent = ContentFrame
StatusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 240, 0, 20)
StatusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
StatusLabel.Text = "Initialisé et Prêt."
StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.TextMuted
StatusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
StatusLabel.TextSize = 11

-- =============================================================================
-- BOUCLE DE SUIVI (SÉCURISÉE)
-- =============================================================================
local blockCheckPos = nil
local blockCheckTime = os.clock()
local lastFollowUpdate = os.clock()

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not ScreenGui.Parent then return end
    
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        if not Config.FollowEnabled then
            StatusLabel.Text = "Suivi désactivé"
            blockCheckPos = nil
            return
        end

        if os.clock() - lastFollowUpdate < 0.25 then return end
        lastFollowUpdate = os.clock()

        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        if not (root and hum) then return end

        local target, dist = nil, math.huge
        for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
                local otherRoot = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if otherRoot then
                    local d = (root.Position - otherRoot.Position).Magnitude
                    if d < dist then dist = d; target = p end
                end
            end
        end

        if not target then return end

        if dist > Config.FollowDistance then
            local targetRoot = target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if targetRoot then
                hum:MoveTo(targetRoot.Position)
                StatusLabel.Text = "Suivi : " .. (target.DisplayName or target.Name)

                if os.clock() - blockCheckTime > 0.5 then
                    if blockCheckPos and (root.Position - blockCheckPos).Magnitude < 1 then
                        hum.Jump = true
                    end
                    blockCheckPos = root.Position
                    blockCheckTime = os.clock()
                end
            end
        else
            StatusLabel.Text = "Cible rejointe"
            blockCheckPos = nil
        end
    end)

    if not ok then task.wait(0.5) end
end)

-- =============================================================================
-- ÉCOUTE CHAT
-- =============================================================================
local function safeProcessMessage(player, text)
    if not player or text == "" then return end
    pcall(processMessage, player, text)
end

if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
    TextChatService.MessageReceived:Connect(function(msg)
        if msg.TextSource then
            safeProcessMessage(Players:GetPlayerByUserId(msg.TextSource.UserId), msg.Text)
        end
    end)
else
    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p) p.Chatted:Connect(function(m) safeProcessMessage(p, m) end) end)
    for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do p.Chatted:Connect(function(m) safeProcessMessage(p, m) end) end
end

print("[Verity] Chargement global terminé avec succès.")

end)

if not VerityOk then
    warn("[Verity] Crash évité lors du chargement : " .. tostring(VerityErr))
end
